quality_target: 1.01 * min(area-feasible measured no-op, area-feasible measured native ABC); no-op only if native unavailable/infeasible
runtime_goal: median end-to-end speedup >=1.5, or better validated QoR at equal time; all costs included
no_inner_ablation_scope: Only inner backward/Adam removed; full small-branch proxy calibration or large-branch DAG adjoint/feedback retained. Not a fully gradient-free method; standalone random is the non-gradient baseline.
cache_policy: isolated cold children per method/input/seed; unused ML not loaded by random/native; page cache not flushed
scope: Prospective frozen evaluation on already analyzed data, not an unseen test set. Protocol is not an executed result. Failed/censored methods and no-op are retained; nonpositive-gain development negative results excluded from the primary method without changing the original panel.
